source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Modular Ice Maker Service Sheet (Part 2225623, 120 V)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator or disconnect power before resistance checks or module removal. Restore power only for live voltage checks when required.
steps.sourceExcerpt: MODULE OHMMETER CHECKS (no power; ejector blades in PARK).

steps.title: Access fill adjustment
steps.body: Pull water-adjustment knob and snap off cover. Index knob on reinstall.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Pull water-adjustment knob and snap off cover. Index knob on reinstall.

steps.title: Fill adjustment direction
steps.body: Clockwise DECREASES fill. ½ turn ≈ 20 cc (1.2 sec); 1 full turn ≈ 40 cc (2.4 sec). Max 1 turn either direction — over-adjust damages module.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Clockwise DECREASES fill. ½ turn ≈ 20 cc (1.2 sec); 1 full turn ≈ 40 cc (2.4 sec). Max 1 turn either direction — over-adjust damages module.

steps.title: Small or hollow cubes?
steps.body: Are cubes undersized or hollow (under-fill symptom)?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Are cubes undersized or hollow (under-fill symptom)?

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Fill volume acceptable — investigate other causes.

steps.title: Increase fill (CCW)
steps.body: Turn fill screw counter-clockwise up to ½ turn. Run harvest cycle and re-check 140 cc / 7.5 s target.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Turn fill screw counter-clockwise up to ½ turn. Run harvest cycle and re-check 140 cc / 7.5 s target.

steps.title: Fill adjusted
steps.oemOutcome: Fill screw adjusted — verify 140 cc / 7.5 s after change.

steps.title: No fill adjustment needed
steps.oemOutcome: Cube size normal — fill adjustment not required.
